test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 23 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What was India's first supercomputer called?
solution:
The correct answer is __**PARAM 8000**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **PARAM **is a **series of supercomputers designed **and **assembled **by the **Centre for Development of Advanced Computing **(C-DAC) in **Pune**, **India**.
 
• **PARAM **means **"supreme" **in the **Sanskrit language**, whilst also creating an acronym for **"PARAllel Machine". **As of **June 2021**, the fastest machine in the **series is the PARAM Siddhi AI **which ranks **89th in the world **with a **Rpeak of 5.267 petaflops.**
 
• The **PARAM 8000 **was the **first machine **in the series and was built from scratch. **A prototype was benchmarked **at the **"1990 Zurich Super-computing Show" **of the **machines **that ran at the show it came second only to one from the United States.
 
• 
 
It was created in **three months at a cost of ₹160 million (US$2 million) **- the first Indian supercomputer.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **ENIAC **was the **first programmable, electronic, general-purpose digital computer**, **completed **in **1945**. It was **Turing-complete **and able to **solve "a large class of numerical problems**" through **reprogramming**.
 
• **SAGA-220 **is a **supercomputer **built by the **Indian Space Research Organisation**. It was **unveiled **on **2 May 2011 **by **Dr. K. Radhakrishnan, Chairman, ISRO. **
